Name: Horizontal Positional Accuracy
Description: This TRE is used describe the horizontal accuracy when the vertical accuracy varies across the region for which horizontal accuracy is constant.

NUM_ACHZ.Name: Number of horizontal accuracy regions
NUM_ACHZ.Description: This field shall contain the number of horizontal accuracy regions to follow.

UNIAAH<NUM_ACHZ>.Name: Unit of Measure for AAH
UNIAAH<NUM_ACHZ>.Description: This field shall contain the units of measure (UoM) for the corresponding AAHn field or all BCS spaces (0x20) if the absolute horizontal accuracy is unknown or not applicable. Note original values are from DIGEST Ed. 2.1 Part 3-7.

AAH<NUM_ACHZ>.Name: Absolute Horizontal Accuracy
AAH<NUM_ACHZ>.Description: This field is omitted when UNIAAHn contains all BCS spaces (0x20). Otherwise, this field shall contain the absolute horizontal accuracy for the nth region of horizontal positional accuracy.

UNIAPH<NUM_ACHZ>.Name: Unit of Measure for APH
UNIAPH<NUM_ACHZ>.Description: This field shall contain the units of measure (UoM) for the corresponding APHn field or all BCS spaces (0x20) if the point-to-point (relative) horizontal accuracy is unknown or not applicable. Note original values are from DIGEST Ed. 2.1 Part 3-7.

APH<NUM_ACHZ>.Name: Point-to-Point Horizontal Accuracy
APH<NUM_ACHZ>.Description: This field is omitted when UNIAPHn contains all BCS spaces (0x20). Otherwise, this field shall contain the point-to-point (relative) horizontal accuracy for the nth horizontal positional accuracy region.

NUM_PTS<NUM_ACHZ>.Name: Number of Points in the Bounding Polygon
NUM_PTS<NUM_ACHZ>.Description: This field defines the number of points (coordinate pairs) that are used to define the bounding polygon of the nth region of horizontal accuracy. Coordinate values shall refer to the coordinate system and units defined in GEOPS (and possibly in PRJPS). Whenever possible, the first and last points should be the same in order to close the polygon (e.g., a rectangular region would report five points), although this is not a strict requirement. If the accuracy information applies to the entire Image Segment (the value of NUM_ACHZ = 1 and the ACCPO extension is not present), then this field does not apply and will contain 000.

LON<NUM_PTS<NUM_ACHZ>>.Name: Longitude / Easting
LON<NUM_PTS<NUM_ACHZ>>.Description: This field shall be omitted when the value of NUM_PTSn is 000. Otherwise, this field shall contain the Easting (when the value of GEOPS.UNI is M) or Longitude (otherwise) of the mth polygon point.

LAT<NUM_PTS<NUM_ACHZ>>.Name: Latitude / Northing
LAT<NUM_PTS<NUM_ACHZ>>.Description: This field shall be omitted when the value of NUM_PTSn is 000. Otherwise, this field shall contain the Northing (when the value of GEOPS.UNI is M) or Latitude (otherwise) of the mth polygon point.
